_comment: ElevenLabs prompts for every game sound. name = Game.Audio.Sfx / Loop enum name (Unity loads Assets/Resources/Audio/<name>). kind: sfx | loop | music. gain = extra level after peak normalisation (1 = -1 dBFS peak). Edit a prompt and re-run soundgen.py --only <name> --force.
style: bright cartoon arcade game, clean, punchy, no voice, no music unless stated

sounds.name: Coin
sounds.prompt: single bright coin pickup chime, two quick ascending metallic notes, arcade game collectible, short and clean

sounds.name: Diamond
sounds.prompt: magical sparkling gem pickup, shimmering ascending glass arpeggio with a twinkly tail, cartoon game reward

sounds.name: NitroPickup
sounds.prompt: power-up pickup, quick rising electric synth whoosh with a charged-up zap at the end, arcade racing game

sounds.name: NitroFire
sounds.prompt: nitro boost ignition, deep punchy thump followed by a roaring jet whoosh accelerating away, arcade racing game turbo

sounds.name: CarveBoost
sounds.prompt: quick speed boost swoosh with rising pitch and a small bright chime on top, skateboard arcade game

sounds.name: Ollie
sounds.prompt: skateboard ollie pop, sharp wooden tail snap on concrete, single clean hit, close up

sounds.name: PerfectOllie
sounds.prompt: skateboard ollie pop, sharp wooden tail snap followed by a bright magical sparkle chime, arcade game perfect trick

sounds.name: Land
sounds.prompt: big longboard landing on asphalt, heavy wooden deck thud with urethane wheels slapping the ground, single impact

sounds.name: Bump
sounds.prompt: skateboard wheels rolling over a small bump in the road, short muffled knock

sounds.name: Hit
sounds.prompt: skateboard crashing into a plastic traffic cone and crate, crunchy cartoon impact with a plastic clatter

sounds.name: Crash
sounds.prompt: big cartoon wipeout, giant skateboard slamming into the road, wooden crash, tumbling bodies and wheels clattering on asphalt, comedic not violent

sounds.name: NearMiss
sounds.prompt: fast close pass-by whoosh, air rushing past an object at high speed, doppler swish

sounds.name: ComboUp
sounds.prompt: short upbeat arcade level-up blip, quick rising two-note synth, positive game UI feedback

sounds.name: Slipstream
sounds.prompt: soft airy wind tunnel whoosh building up, drafting behind a car at speed

sounds.name: CountdownTick
sounds.prompt: race start countdown beep, single clean electronic tone, arcade racing game

sounds.name: CountdownGo
sounds.prompt: race start GO signal, higher bright electronic beep chord with a short energetic whoosh, arcade racing game

sounds.name: UiMove
sounds.prompt: tiny soft menu cursor tick, clean short UI click for a cartoon game

sounds.name: UiSelect
sounds.prompt: friendly menu confirm sound, short bright two-note pop upward, cartoon game UI

sounds.name: UiBack
sounds.prompt: menu back sound, short soft two-note pop downward, cartoon game UI

sounds.name: Join
sounds.prompt: player joins the game, cheerful quick ascending three-note chime with a pop, party game lobby

sounds.name: Respawn
sounds.prompt: respawn sound, soft magical rising whoosh with a gentle shimmer, cartoon game

sounds.name: Wind
sounds.prompt: steady strong wind rushing past the ears while riding fast downhill, continuous airflow, no gusts dropping out

sounds.name: Roll
sounds.prompt: continuous rolling of big urethane skateboard wheels on smooth asphalt, steady low rumble with fine road grain

sounds.name: NitroBurn
sounds.prompt: continuous jet booster roar, steady rocket thruster burn with slight flutter, arcade racing nitro

sounds.name: Music
sounds.prompt: upbeat energetic instrumental party game music, sunny summer surf-pop meets electro, 128 BPM, driving drums, funky bass, bright synth hooks, fun and exciting, seamless loopable, no vocals
